question: What quality of knowledge makes this teaching bestow every siddhi?
premises: Knowledge spans this world and the next.
inference: The verse identifies all-siddhi-bestowing knowledge as encompassing both worldly and otherworldly cognition.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of mayī within the compound remains unresolved.
plain_english: It is full of knowledge of this world and the next, and it gives all siddhis.
